body.purpose: All site copy, controls, and navigation.

label.purpose: Uppercase workflow-stage labels at regular width.

components.name: Primary Download Button
components.description: Periwinkle free-download action in the hero, header, and download panel.
components.html: Télécharger gratuitement
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: #A3B8FF; color: #141820; font: 600 16px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-button-primary svg { display: block; width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #B6C7FF; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #A3B8FF; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-primary:active { background: #B6C7FF; }

components.name: Desktop Navigation
components.description: Section links in muted text plus the persistent release action.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; color: #D0D6E0; font: 400 14px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #E6EAF0; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #A3B8FF; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 3px; }

components.name: Mobile Menu Trigger
components.description: 44px surface control for the compact native details navigation.
components.html: <button class="ds-menu-toggle" type="button" aria-label="Afficher la navigation"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="22" height="22" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-menu-toggle { display: inline-flex; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid #343C49; border-radius: 6px; background: #1C222C; color: #E6EAF0; } .ds-menu-toggle:hover { background: #252D39; } .ds-menu-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #A3B8FF; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-menu-toggle:active { background: #252D39; } .ds-menu-toggle svg { display: block; }

components.name: Application Screenshot
components.description: Genuine dark app capture with zoom action and original-image link.
components.css: .ds-app-capture { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #343C49; border-radius: 12px; background: #1C222C; box-shadow: 0 28px 72px rgb(0 0 0 / 34%), 0 1px 0 rgb(163 184 255 / 12%) inset; } .ds-app-capture a { position: relative; display: block; cursor: zoom-in; } .ds-app-capture img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; } .ds-app-capture .ds-zoom { position: absolute; right: 12px; bottom: 12px; display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #4A5670; border-radius: 6px; background: #1C222C; color: #A3B8FF; font: 600 12px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgb(0 0 0 / 32%); } .ds-app-capture .ds-zoom svg { display: block; width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-app-capture a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #A3B8FF; outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-app-capture figcaption { margin-top: 12px; color: #B1BBC9; font: 400 12px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', sans-serif; }

components.name: Workflow Route
components.description: Compact three-stage route with a moving periwinkle signal on each connector.
components.html:
1. Écrire
  3. Relire
  5. PDF
components.css: .ds-workflow { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; margin: 0; padding: 0; color: #B1BBC9; font: 500 12px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; list-style: none; } .ds-track { position: relative; width: clamp(28px, 6vw, 72px); height: 1px; flex: 0 1 auto; background: #4A5670; } .ds-track::after { position: absolute; top: -2.5px; left: 0; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #A3B8FF; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgb(163 184 255 / 72%); content: ''; animation: ds-flow-signal 3.2s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1) infinite alternate; } .ds-track:nth-of-type(2)::after { animation-delay: 350ms; } @keyframes ds-flow-signal { from { left: 0; } to { left: calc(100% - 6px); } } @media (max-width: 680px) { .ds-workflow { gap: 8px; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .05em; } .ds-track { width: clamp(16px, 7vw, 28px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-track::after { animation: none; } }

components.name: FAQ Disclosure
components.description: Native details disclosure with an accent plus/minus state marker.
components.html:
En quoi markdim diffère de MDViewer ?

Les deux ouvrent, éditent et exportent des fichiers Markdown. markdim publie son code sous MIT et propose une bêta publique Linux en plus de Windows.
components.css: .ds-faq { border-top: 1px solid #343C49; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-faq:last-child { border-bottom: 1px solid #343C49; } .ds-faq summary { display: flex; min-height: 60px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; color: #E6EAF0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-faq summary::after { color: #A3B8FF; content: '+'; font-size: 1.3rem; } .ds-faq[open] summary::after { content: '−'; } .ds-faq p { max-width: 68ch; margin: 0; padding: 0 0 20px; color: #D0D6E0; line-height: 1.7; } .ds-faq summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #A3B8FF; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
markdim's site is a modern, dark, lively product launch: confident and polished, with the actual application—not decorative campaign art—as its proof. Deep blue-charcoal surfaces, cool readable text, fine slate borders, and markdim's periwinkle accents carry the app identity. IBM Plex Sans Variable handles the complete typographic voice, from oversized launch headline to compact route labels.

The first view centers the direct “Lire. Écrire. Exporter.” promise and free-download action above a genuine, clickable dark-mode application capture. A short animated signal traces Écrire → Relire → PDF. Below, rule-separated asymmetrical feature rows and ruled preference panes explain the product without generic card grids. Brief entrance and route motion add energy; reduced-motion preference disables animation and transitions.
keyCharacteristics: Dark product palette and legible cool-toned copy.
Periwinkle actions and one animated workflow signal.
One self-hosted sans-serif family across display, body, and labels.
Real application capture above asymmetric, rule-separated feature rows.
dos: Do keep site color tokens aligned with `global.css`; use the shipped app palette as the identity source.
Do lead with the real dark-mode application capture and preserve its aspect ratio.
Do reserve the bright accent for actions, focus, links, and workflow signal.
Do structure feature content with asymmetric rows and rules rather than generic card grids.
Do preserve reduced-motion behavior and native disclosure semantics.
Do state platform targets separately from currently available beta packages.
Do keep the OpenCode use case secondary to everyday Markdown editing.
donts: Don't reintroduce the previous light paper/editorial palette.
Don't fabricate an application screenshot or imply a macOS beta package is currently published.
Don't position AI as the product's main purpose.
Don't turn the factual MDViewer comparison into a claim that markdim alone can edit or export Markdown.
Don't remove the animated route or make motion ignore reduced-motion preferences.
